A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same solver–verifier-gap framework. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original self-improvement, cross-improvement, solver/verifier evaluation, and Pass@K experiments in Sections 4–5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains those experiments and adds MBPP evaluations, controlled training-stage comparisons, correlation analyses, and partial F-tests.

M1.justification: The score-filtered, length-normalized Best-of-N selection, SFT objective, and external-response substitution procedure are unchanged. Algorithm 1 moves to Appendix A; the added checkpoint evaluations do not modify the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: v4 adds MBPP code generation to the retained Math, GSM8k, and ProntoQA coverage. Figures 13, 17, and 20 evaluate this distinct task domain across four models.

E2.justification: Appendix E adds a lagged-gap regression as an alternative to the current-gap-only dynamical model, with comparisons reported in Table 4. The original cross-improvement baseline and Early, Uniform, and Late comparator set remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.4 introduces an architecture-controlled EvoLM/Llama-2-1B study comparing base-plus-SFT, math-mid-trained-plus-SFT, and fully post-trained checkpoints. New MBPP trajectories extend through epoch 12. The previously reported ten-epoch protocol and SFT hyperparameters are retained.

E4.justification: v4 adds analyses of upstream training-stage effects, uncertainty–accuracy correlations, and whether historical gap information improves prediction of dynamics (Section 4.4, Table 2, and Appendix E/Table 4). These directly investigate confounders and modeling assumptions beyond v2’s existing sensitivity and diversity analyses.

E5.justification: Beyond the retained ± reporting in Table 1, v4 introduces Pearson correlations with significance thresholds and partial F-tests with F-statistics and p-values. Neither version specifies repeated-run counts or seeds; the additions establish new statistical reporting, not an increase in runs.

E6.justification: v4 adds MBPP results, training-stage trajectories, and correlation/F-test outcomes. For example, Figure 5 reports train-split decay rates of 0.244, 0.182, and 0.074 across the three stages. These are new results under added settings; the retained empirical plots and Table 1 values are unchanged.

T1.justification: The main propositions, corollaries, and Appendix B proofs are retained. However, new Appendix E writes G(t)=Uv(t)−Us(t), reversing the retained definition G(t)=Us(t)−Uv(t) in Equation 6. This introduces a localized mathematical inconsistency without establishing a revised framework.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, conclusion, and relocated contribution list retain the same claims about exponential dynamics, capability limits, and approximate insensitivity to external-data allocation timing. New supporting experiments do not redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: Appendices A.3 and E substantially expand explanations of the uncertainty proxy, family-specific trajectories, and modeling assumptions. v4 identifies distribution changes and dynamic learning-rate schedules as possible limits of constant coefficients, and newly interprets its regression tests as evidence of memoryless dynamics.

D1.justification: Section 4.4 provides specific EvoLM checkpoint identifiers, architecture size, and upstream training histories for the new controlled study. The existing hardware, SFT hyperparameters, batch size, and checkpoint-saving information remain unchanged; the new reproducibility statement mainly supplies pointers.

R1.justification: v4 adds Qi et al. (2025) for EvoLM and a footnote explicitly explaining the terminology’s relationship to Song et al.’s generation–verification gap. The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and the main section sequence are retained. v4 moves the contribution list and Algorithm 1 into Appendix A, creates a dedicated uncertainty discussion, reorganizes appendix headings, and adds disclosure and front-matter text.

P2.justification: v4 adds five substantive figures and two statistical tables, adopts conference formatting, and redistributes appendix displays across pages. Existing graphical content is retained despite renumbering and relocation; the display expansion is substantial.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2, coding evaluations, architecture-controlled training-stage experiments, and quantitative proxy checks strengthen empirical scrutiny. The net gain is limited by problems in the added discussion: Appendix E overstates memorylessness despite Table 4 reporting p=0.0122 for Phi-4-mini on GSM8k test, and introduces a contradictory gap sign. The central theory and proofs remain unchanged.
